        }

    sales_invoices_df['related_count'] = sales_invoices_df['Enterprise Code'].map(lambda x: enterprise_stats.get(x, {}).get('related_count', 0))
    sales_invoices_df['related_sum'] = sales_invoices_df['Enterprise Code'].map(lambda x: enterprise_stats.get(x, {}).get('related_sum', 0))
    
    # 显示前5行丰富化后的数据
    print("\n丰富化后的销售发票数据前5行:")
    print(sales_invoices_df[['Enterprise Code', 'related_count', 'related_sum']].head())
    
    # 保存丰富化后的数据到CSV文件以便查看
    output_path = '⟨workdir⟩'
    sales_invoices_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"\n丰富化后的数据已保存到: {output_path}")
    
    # 显示一些统计信息
    print("\n丰富化字段统计:")
    print(f"总相关记录数: {sales_invoices_df['related_count'].sum()}")
    print(f"总相关金额: {sales_invoices_df['related_sum'].sum():.2f}")
    print(f"平均每个Enterprise Code的相关记录数: {sales_invoices_df['related_count'].mean():.2f}")
    
    # 显示前10个Enterprise Code的统计信息
    print("\n前10个Enterprise Code的统计信息:")
    top_enterprises = sales_invoices_df.groupby('Enterprise Code')[['related_count', 'related_sum']].first().reset_index()
    print(top_enterprises.head(10))
    
else:
    print("错误: 表中未找到'Enterprise Code'列")
    
# 关闭数据库连接
conn.close()
print("\n数据库连接已关闭")

# 保存模型/处理结果（虽然这不是机器学习模型，但我们保存了处理后的数据）

result_data_path = '⟨workdir⟩'

print("\n销售发票数据前5行:")
print(sales_invoices_df.head())

# 获取Enterprise Code的唯一值，用于优化查询
print("\n正在获取唯一的Enterprise Code值...")
unique_enterprise_codes = sales_invoices_df['Enterprise Code'].unique() if 'Enterprise Code' in sales_invoices_df.columns else None

if unique_enterprise_codes is not None:
    print(f"找到 {len(unique_enterprise_codes)} 个唯一的Enterprise Code值")
    
    # 为每个Enterprise Code预计算相关统计数据
    print("正在为每个Enterprise Code预计算相关统计数据...")
    enterprise_stats = {}
    
    for i, code in enumerate(unique_enterprise_codes):
        # 查询相关统计数据
        related_count_query = f'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM nch___input_invoices WHERE "Enterprise Code" = ?'
        related_sum_query = f'SELECT SUM("Amount") as total FROM nch___input_invoices WHERE "Enterprise Code" = ?'
        
        count_result = pd.read_sql_query(related_count_query, conn, params=(code,))
        sum_result = pd.read_sql_query(related_sum_query, conn, params=(code,))
        
        enterprise_stats[code] = {
            'related_count': count_result.iloc[0, 0] if not count_result.empty and count_result.iloc[0, 0] is not None else 0,
            'related_sum': sum_result.iloc[0, 0] if not sum_result.empty and sum_result.iloc[0, 0] is not None else 0
        }
        
        # 显示进度
        if (i + 1) % 100 == 0 or i == len(unique_enterprise_codes) - 1:
            print(f"处理进度: {i + 1}/{len(unique_enterprise_codes)} ({((i + 1)/len(unique_enterprise_codes))*100:.1f}%)")
    
    # 为销售发票数据添加丰富化字段
    print("\n正在为销售发票数据添加丰富化字段...")
    sales_invoices_df['related_count'] = sales_invoices_df['Enterprise Code'].map(lambda x: enterprise_stats.get(x, {}).get('related_count', 0))
    sales_invoices_df['related_sum'] = sales_invoices_df['Enterprise Code'].map(lambda x: enterprise_stats.get(x, {}).get('related_sum', 0))
    
    # 显示前5行丰富化后的数据
    print("\n丰富化后的销售发票数据前5行:")
    print(sales_invoices_df[['Enterprise Code', 'related_count', 'related_sum']].head())
    
    # 保存丰富化后的数据到CSV文件以便查看
    output_path = '⟨workdir⟩'
    sales_invoices_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"\n丰富化后的数据已保存到: {output_path}")
    
    # 显示一些统计信息
    print("\n丰富化字段统计:")
    print(f"总相关记录数: {sales_invoices_df['related_count'].sum()}")
    print(f"总相关金额: {sales_invoices_df['related_sum'].sum():.2f}")
    print(f"平均每个Enterprise Code的相关记录数: {sales_invoices_df['related_count'].mean():.2f}")
    
    # 显示前10个Enterprise Code的统计信息
    print("\n前10个Enterprise Code的统计信息:")
    top_enterprises = sales_invoices_df.groupby('Enterprise Code')[['related_count', 'related_sum']].first().reset_index()
    print(top_enterprises.head(10))
    
else:
    print("错误: 表中未找到'Enterprise Code'列")
